entries.subject: Karkoschka 2003 Neptune inner-moon dimensions
entries.finding: Karkoschka (2003) 48 × 30 × 26 km semiaxes are included as the Shape model; the 29 km JPL radius is reference scale only. Included as Shape model; no elevation lens from an analytic ellipsoid.

entries.subject: PDS Voyager GEOMED images
entries.finding: Excluded as surface textures. Geometry inventory gives best sampling 17.69 km/native pixel (C1135231, 15.36 s exposure), next 21 km/pixel (C1134547). A 96 km maximum diameter spans only about 5 native pixels. Long-exposure smear and sparse geometry do not support terrain mapping. Survey metadata is retained.
entries.revisitWhen: A Naiad observation or controlled reconstruction demonstrates useful native surface detail, body-fixed geometry and independent registration beyond the cited sampling or coverage limits.

entries.subject: HST recovery of Naiad, Showalter et al. (2019)
entries.finding: Astrometry and unresolved detections, not a surface map.
entries.revisitWhen: A spatially resolved Naiad measurement supplies original spectral or image samples with body-fixed coordinates and enough coverage to qualify a mapped lens.

entries.subject: PDS Stooke shape release
entries.finding: No Naiad model listed; no detailed mesh adopted.
entries.revisitWhen: The inspected shape archive or a cited primary release publishes a Naiad-specific numerical model with its frame, units and reconstruction method.

entries.subject: USGS mapping and published photometry
entries.finding: No usable Naiad cartographic or spatial scalar product found in this pass. Disk-integrated photometry does not supply local color or elevation.
entries.revisitWhen: A spatially resolved Naiad measurement supplies original spectral or image samples with body-fixed coordinates and enough coverage to qualify a mapped lens.
